name: Omatune
author: qempexe
description: Song recognition in your Omarchy bar: click to listen, then see the song, artist and cover in a notification and in the history.

barWidget.description: Song recognition with theme, notification and history settings

schema.label: Theme
schema.description: Follow Omarchy changes the moment you switch Omarchy's theme. Custom lets you choose every colour. Monochrome is plain grey.

schema.label: Custom background
schema.description: Background colour used with the Custom theme.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Text colour used with the Custom theme.

schema.label: Custom accent
schema.description: Accent colour used with the Custom theme.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Up to 8 characters shown on the bar.

schema.label: Show last song on the bar
schema.description: Show the last song found next to the icon.

schema.label: Listen to
schema.description: This computer records what is playing. Microphone listens to the room.

schema.label: Listen length
schema.description: How long to record before identifying. 4 to 6 seconds is usually enough; longer is slower but more reliable in noisy rooms.

schema.label: Notify when a song is found
schema.description: Send a desktop notification with the song title and artist.

schema.label: Cover photo in notification
schema.description: Include the album cover when one is available.

schema.label: Notification time
schema.description: How long the notification stays on screen.

schema.label: Songs to keep
schema.description: How many songs the History tab remembers.
